name: pos-web
description: The POS web apps on one site: frontend-nav (the portal, /), frontend-buy (the online shop, /buy), frontend-cas (the till, /cas), frontend-ctl (administration, /ctl) and frontend-app (the mobile app's download page, /app), sharing @pos/shared.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w frontend-ctl & npm run dev -w frontend-cas & npm run dev -w frontend-buy & npm run dev -w frontend-app & npm run dev -w frontend-nav
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend-ctl && npm run build -w frontend-cas && npm run build -w frontend-buy && npm run build -w frontend-app && npm run build -w frontend-nav
